entries.title: DRAFT: endpoint control in parafermionic identification
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent referee pending. On the upper half-plane with the upper logarithm, for 0<sigma<=1 and epsilon>0, z^(-sigma)(1+epsilon/z^2) has the same positive boundary rays as z^(-sigma) and the same z^sigma F->1 normalization at infinity, but differs. Even the nonvanishing function z^(-sigma)exp(epsilon/z^2) has those data. Boundary phases and infinity normalization alone do not prove uniqueness. A uniform bound on z^sigma F near zero, real continuous boundary values away from zero, and uniform infinity normalization do imply F=z^(-sigma) by reflection, removability, and Liouville.
assumptions: Analytic in H; upper logarithm; continuous boundary values away from marked endpoint 0
No FK endpoint estimate is proved here

entries.title: DRAFT: uniform path convergence does not preserve martingales
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent referee pending. For a unit-rate Poisson process N, M^n_t=1-t+nN_{t/n}, 0<=t<=1, is a nonnegative true martingale in its own natural filtration. Its paths eventually equal 1-t on the entire interval almost surely, because the first Poisson jump time is positive. Thus it converges uniformly almost surely to a continuous deterministic non-martingale. Uniform integrability is absent: E[M^n_t]=1 but E[1-t]=1-t. Joint path convergence alone cannot pass a renormalized observable's conditional martingale identity to the limit.
assumptions: Each prelimit uses the time-changed Poisson natural filtration
This is an abstract inference counterexample, not an FK counterexample

entries.title: DRAFT: complex observable identifies the Loewner driver
entries.statement: DRAFT; independent referee pending. Let sigma>0 and W_0=0 be a real continuous adapted chordal Loewner driver, with dg_t=2/(g_t-W_t)dt. If exp(sigma(Log g'_t(z)-Log(g_t(z)-W_t))) is a full complex continuous local martingale in the same usual filtration for every z=im, m a positive integer, before swallowing, then W has bracket 8t/(1+sigma), zero drift, and W/sqrt(8/(1+sigma)) is Brownian motion. Recover the semimartingale premise from a local inverse of the nonzero observable; Ito's imaginary finite-variation equation removes signed drift. This conditional route does not establish discrete observable convergence.
assumptions: Both real and imaginary parts are local martingales

entries.title: DRAFT: precise remaining C0049 observable gap
entries.statement: DRAFT. For the square-lattice FK-to-SLE observable route, the unresolved input is convergence of the correctly normalized vertex observable (2delta)^(-sigma)f_delta in actual explored slit domains to a fixed deterministic multiple of (g'_t/(g_t-W_t))^sigma, together with common localization, joint convergence of stopped histories, and stopped uniform integrability. Static-domain convergence or weak contour equations alone do not provide this input. The historical C0049 attempt's additional-discrete-relation strategy is sufficient if completed, not a proved necessary characterization of every solution route. Full target openness is UNKNOWN here; q<1 critical tuning and tightness also require verification.
assumptions: Source target is Dobrushin square-lattice bond FK; triangular site percolation is different
No C0049 solved or retired claim

entries.title: Source status: October 2026 q=4 free-loop convergence
entries.statement: As checked on 2026-10-10, Averous, Duminil-Copin, He, Lammers and Manolescu, arXiv:2610.08507v1 (6 October 2026), Theorem 1.2 states that critical square-lattice random-cluster loop ensembles with q=4 and p=2/3, free boundary conditions, and Caratheodory domain approximation converge weakly to nested CLE(4) in the Camia-Newman topology. This is a checked primary theorem statement; its proof is not independently audited here. The stated theorem does not itself assert Dobrushin chordal-interface convergence. It qualifies older blanket open-status records but does not automatically retire the exact C0049 target.
assumptions: Free boundary loop ensembles; square lattice; q=4 p=2/3
Primary-source statement check is separate from proof review

relations.rationale: The route requires 'stopped uniform integrability'; the Poisson counterexample establishes why 'joint path convergence alone' is insufficient.
The gap names the limiting full complex martingale; the conditional identification entry derives the driver only after that input.
The gap requires identification of the analytic limit; the endpoint example prevents replacing that identification by boundary phases alone.
Existing target is 'critical random-cluster ... Dobrushin domains'; this entry isolates the random-slit observable route to that target.
Existing target includes q in (0,4]; Theorem 1.2 now gives q=4 free-loop CLE4 convergence, with a different stated boundary observable.
